sessionStart.prompt: This project asks agents to warn when the chat is too long and a new conversation would be safer (rule: warn-long-conversation.mdc). Check whether this session already had context overflow / memory snapshot / huge multi-topic history. If yes, return additional_context telling the agent to warn the user once at the start of the next reply that they should move to a new chat. If no, return empty additional_context. Do not block the session. Input: $ARGUMENTS
